written.myAnswer: For the symmetric arrangement shown, T₁ = T₂ = 2.5 N.

First condition: The vector sum of all external forces is zero (ΣFₓ = 0 and ΣFᵧ = 0), so there is no linear acceleration. Second condition: The sum of torques about any point is zero (Στ = 0), so there is no angular acceleration.
An accelerated body has a non-zero resultant force, so it does not satisfy the first condition of equilibrium, ΣF = 0.
For the symmetric arrangement shown, T₁ = T₂ = 100 N.
Tensions in the two strings are 86.6 N and 173.2 N, respectively.
